## History

Ludovic Speed is an elderly man involved in a local love affair in [Valley Road](../codex/places.md#valley-road), where [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) boards with Miss [Janet](../character/janet.md) Sweet during her time at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) observes his romantic situation from afar while staying at [Wayside](../codex/places.md#wayside). Mindful of past experiences, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) vows not to meddle in his relationship.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Again P1](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0001), [v3 ch.Again P2](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0002), [v3 ch.Again P3](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0003), [v3 ch.Again P4](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0004), [v3 ch.Again P5](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0005), [v3 ch.Again P8](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0008), +59 more_

## Relationships

### [Theodora Dix](../character/theodora-dix.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/ludovic-speed--theodora-dix.md)

Ludovic Speed and [Theodora Dix](../character/theodora-dix.md) share a long-standing, placid romantic involvement. Their quiet courtship is eventually helped along by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) during her time observing the local residents of [Valley Road](../codex/places.md#valley-road).
